documents_product_url.name: documents_product_url
documents_product_url.where: "documents"."external_url_key" is not null and "documents"."deleted_at" is null

documents_external.name: documents_external
documents_external.value: "documents"."source" <> 'external' or ("documents"."external_url" is not null and "documents"."external_url_key" is not null and "documents"."current_revision_id" is null)

notification_deliveries_source.name: notification_deliveries_source
notification_deliveries_source.value: ("notification_deliveries"."kind" = 'rule' and "notification_deliveries"."rule_id" is not null and "notification_deliveries"."schedule_id" is null) or ("notification_deliveries"."kind" = 'schedule' and "notification_deliveries"."schedule_id" is not null and "notification_deliveries"."rule_id" is null) or ("notification_deliveries"."kind" in ('test', 'personal') and "notification_deliveries"."rule_id" is null and "notification_deliveries"."schedule_id" is null)
